steps.title: Plan your shoots
steps.text: Allow time for culling your photos.

steps.title: Send me your dates
steps.text: For example: “On November 10, 20 and 30, I’ll send three wedding galleries.”

steps.title: We confirm the schedule
steps.text: I reserve time for editing, and you know exactly when your photos will be ready.

important.title: Important
important.text: Booking means reserving my working time for your order.
important.warning: If your plans change, just let me know in advance. If a gallery doesn’t arrive on the agreed date without notice, the booking is no longer valid, and the new deadlines depend on my workload.
important.cta: To book or place a new order, send me a DM.
